blurb: Stash 9.0.1 is an early February 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's from-scratch C UCI chess engine, prior to its transposition table and quiescence search. It pairs magic bitboards and Zobrist hashing with iterative deepening principal variation search, MVV-LVA and piece-square move ordering, and a piece-count tapered piece-square evaluation with a castling-rights bonus. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper.

features.label: Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit piece-type and color bitboards with legal move generation.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards with precomputed bishop and rook attack tables.

features.label: Zobrist Hashing
features.implementation: Incremental 64-bit Zobrist position keys used for repetition detection.

features.label: Iterative Deepening
features.implementation: Depth-by-depth root search with basic time allocation and node-count limits.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax alpha-beta search using zero-window probes after the first move with full-window re-searches.

features.label: MVV-LVA & PSQT Ordering
features.implementation: Static move scoring ordering promotions, captures by MVV-LVA, castling, and quiet moves by PSQT delta.

features.label: Piece-Square Tables
features.implementation: Incrementally maintained packed middlegame and endgame piece-square score pairs.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Linear interpolation between middlegame and endgame scores by total piece count, plus a castling-rights bonus.
